meta.name: render-mosaic-grid-reveal
meta.description: Render a 'mosaic-grid-reveal' video from a config — a real-DOM FULL-BLEED N×N mosaic of real product tiles that pops in one tile at a time (scatter order, ease-out-back overshoot), the grid clears, then the brand wordmark builds line-by-line followed by a sub-label, tagline, and CTA; frame-stepped via Playwright and encoded with FFmpeg — deterministic assembly, FREE (the music bed comes from create-music-elevenlabs), so the wordmark, tile captions, and CTA stay pixel-crisp. Use for the mosaic-grid-reveal format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据配置生成一个“马赛克网格揭示”视频：先逐块弹出产品图片网格，然后网格消失，再逐行显示品牌标志、副标题、标语和行动号召按钮。视频通过 Playwright 逐帧截图并用 FFmpeg 编码，文字和图片保持像素级清晰。
howto.when: 当你要求制作“马赛克网格揭示”格式的视频，并提供品牌标志、产品图片、配色方案和文案等配置时触发。
